- 2.
 Marine Troopers should make themselves readily available to the crew, either by patrolling actively or by guarding departments. - 3.
 Marine Troopers are cleared to confine sentenced criminals in the brig for up to [bold]10 minutes[/bold].

 3.1
 For a sentence to be valid, it must be read aloud to the Marine Quartermaster or Marine CO. If done over radio, an audible confirmation must be received.

 3.2
 Marine Troopers are responsible for ensuring that any sentences they themselves were involved in are properly documented in the Criminal Records System. - 4.
 When practical, Marine Troopers should patrol in pairs.
